    org.clafer 0.6.0 API

    The Java API of the Java tools of Clafer: clafersg, the Clafer solution generator (formerly chocosolver), claferc and the language server clafer-ls, version 0.6.0, released with Clafer 0.6.0 on Nov 29, 2026.

    clafersg

    • The command is clafersg (clafersg.jar), for instance generation and multi-objective optimization with Choco 6.0.2, and the traces of temporal models with Alloy 6.2.0. clafersg --version prints clafersg v0.6.0.<build date>.
    • chocosolver, its old name, is deprecated: Clafer Tools 0.6.0 no longer installs it, nor chocosolver.jar, and there is no alias.
    • clafersg reads .cfr models directly with its Java frontend and writes no .js file. It runs clafer -m choco itself for a model with a [choco| |] escape and with --haskell-frontend, using the clafer next to its jar, or the one on the PATH. .js files still work.
    • On a temporal model, clafersg solves with Alloy 6.2.0 in the same JVM, and --repl is claferIG's REPL; the launcher passes the optimized MiniSat prover.
    • New: claferc, the Clafer compiler's -m clafer, --core, --meta-data and -m alloy in Java, and clafer-ls, the Clafer language server (LSP).

    Maven

    The parent project is org.clafer:org.clafer, with four modules:

    ArtifactModuleContents
    org.clafer:clafersg (was org.clafer:chocosolver)solver/ the solver: the AST, the IR, the Choco compiler and the CLI
    org.clafer:clafer-frontendfrontend/ the Java frontend: the parser of .cfr models, the explicit IR, and claferc
    org.clafer:clafer-alloyalloy/ the Alloy 6 backend for temporal models
    org.clafer:clafer-language-serverlsp/ clafer-ls, on Eclipse LSP4J
    <dependency>
    <groupId>org.clafer</groupId>
    <artifactId>clafersg</artifactId>
    <version>0.6.0</version>
</dependency>

    Clafer Tools 0.6.0

    The binaries are on Clafer Tools - Binary Distributions. The release has three assets, each with its checksum <file>.sha256:

    • clafer-tools-java-0.6.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz: clafersg, claferc, clafer-ls and the optimized MiniSat prover;
    • clafer-tools-haskell-0.6.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz: clafer and claferIG;
    • clafer-syntax-0.6.0.vsix: the VS Code extension clafer-vscode.

    The two bundles unpack into the same folder, clafer-tools-0.6.0/, and together they are the whole toolset.

    See the README and the change log.
